title: ZTIE per-intake status read-model contract (v1)
description: The bounded, DERIVED per-intake STATUS READ-MODEL assembled by the Story 4.1 Hub-side status-retrieval orchestrator (RD-041) — the Phase-4 opener. For one intake it READS the current Hub tracking item and consolidates the already-derived Phase-3 fields (`combined_event` 3.1 / `correlation_result` 3.2 / `scoring_result` 3.3 / `remediation_result` 3.4 / `verdict_result` 3.5) into ONE bounded view the Phase-4 dashboard payload (4.2) + per-execution report (4.5) consume: intake identity + the furthest pipeline stage reached + per-stage presence/status + the three 3.3 scores (echoed context) + a bounded findings/remediation SUMMARY (counts + the 3.4 status; NOT full findings text) + the 3.5 ADVISORY `recommended_verdict` + the (pending) human `decision`. It is an ON-DEMAND DERIVED TRANSPORT SHAPE, NOT a durable stored record: 4.1 is a READ/transform behind an orchestrator Lambda, it adds NO durable tracking field and does NOT hang off the tracking-table stream. It is READ/transform only — it does NOT re-normalize / re-correlate / re-score / rebuild findings / re-derive the verdict (those are 3.1-3.5, done) and makes NO model call (no Bedrock client, no Bedrock grant). It is Hub-SIDE only (RD-009): it reasons ONLY over the derived Hub-side fields, NEVER the raw payload / findings text / raw trace (which never leave Forensic), and it never crosses the RD-013 gate; it carries NO gate discriminator. CRUCIALLY (RD-040), the 3.5 recommendation it surfaces is ADVISORY and NEVER acted upon: nothing routes / promotes / destroys / moves an artifact on it; the enforcement decision is a HUMAN actively selecting PASS or FAIL at the Phase-4 gate (4.4/4.6/4.7). This view therefore surfaces the recommendation ALONGSIDE the human `decision`, whose only value 4.1 can report is `pending`; the advisory field is named `recommended_verdict` (NOT a bare `verdict`) so no consumer mistakes it for the effective decision, and there is deliberately NO bare `verdict` / `safe` / `approved` / `forward` / `pass_fail` / `malicious` / `clean` field. Allow-list: additionalProperties false at every level; every field typed and enum/length/range-bounded; every array maxItems-capped. Integrity-keyed by intake_id + sha256. DERIVED-ONLY. OWN version pin (STATUS_CONTRACT_VERSION).

contract_version.description: Status read-model schema version. Pinned SEPARATELY on the 4.1 Lambda (STATUS_CONTRACT_VERSION) so this shape versions independently of every stored-record contract's pin.

intake_id.description: The intake UUIDv4 this status view is for (the tracking-record key).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw artifact body all lanes inspected. Integrity key, bound to intake_id; the view is over exactly this artifact's derived record.

assembled_at.description: RFC3339/ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (Z-suffixed) the 4.1 Lambda ASSEMBLED this view in the Hub. The only wall-clock field 4.1 stamps; a read-model assembly time, not a pipeline event time.

overall_stage.description: The FURTHEST pipeline stage reached for this intake, reported HONESTLY from which derived fields are present (received / classified / collected / correlated / scored / assessed / recommended). NOT a verdict — it says how far the pipeline got, never that the artifact is safe/unsafe.

status.description: Optional pass-through of the tracking record's own lifecycle `status` string (e.g. RECEIVED), echoed for the dashboard. Bounded, inert text; NOT a verdict.

received_at.description: Optional pass-through of the intake's `received_at` timestamp (when the artifact was received), echoed for the dashboard's timeline.

stages.description: Per-stage presence/status for the Phase-3 pipeline (which derived fields have landed on the tracking item). Presence facts, never verdicts.

verdict_recommendation.description: Story 3.5 verdict_result (advisory recommendation) presence. Named `verdict_recommendation` (not `verdict`) so this presence flag is never mistaken for an effective-verdict field.

scores.description: The three 3.3 lane scores echoed for CONTEXT + traceability (static / dynamic / combined; the combined lane is RD-038's whole-picture number). Present when a scoring_result is on the item. NEVER re-blended into a new number. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

static.description: The static lane's 3.3 score, echoed as context. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

status.description: This lane's 3.3 score status (scored / model_error / unparseable / skipped_no_evidence), carried through honestly. NOT a verdict.

score.description: The 0-100 risk score (higher = riskier) from 3.3, present ONLY when status is 'scored'. Echoed context, never re-blended. A descriptive EVIDENCE metric, never a decision.

dynamic.description: The dynamic lane's 3.3 score, echoed as context. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

status.description: This lane's 3.3 score status (scored / model_error / unparseable / skipped_no_evidence), carried through honestly. NOT a verdict.

score.description: The 0-100 risk score (higher = riskier) from 3.3, present ONLY when status is 'scored'. Echoed context, never re-blended. A descriptive EVIDENCE metric, never a decision.

combined.description: The combined lane's 3.3 score (RD-038's whole-picture number). EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

status.description: This lane's 3.3 score status (scored / model_error / unparseable / skipped_no_evidence), carried through honestly. NOT a verdict.

score.description: The 0-100 risk score (higher = riskier) from 3.3, present ONLY when status is 'scored'. Echoed context, never re-blended. A descriptive EVIDENCE metric, never a decision.

rubric_version.description: The shared 0-100 risk-rubric version from the 3.3 scoring_result, carried through so the scores are known comparable.

findings_summary.description: A bounded SUMMARY of the 3.4 remediation_result: its status + the by-category counts + how many prioritized remediations exist. NOT the full findings text (the dashboard/report fetch detail as needed). Present when a remediation_result is on the item. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

status.description: The 3.4 remediation_result status carried through (e.g. assessed / no_scores / skipped_no_evidence). NOT a verdict.

finding_count.description: Number of detailed findings surfaced by 3.4.

candidate_false_positive_count.description: Number of candidate false positives 3.4 flagged.

highest_gap_severity.description: The worst gap severity 3.4 saw (context). A high-severity gap is a reason for a human look, never an auto-FAIL. EVIDENCE, never a verdict.

contradiction_present.description: True iff a contradiction finding was present (the lanes disagree). A descriptive fact carried through, never a verdict.

recommendation.description: The 3.5 ADVISORY recommendation surfaced ALONGSIDE the human decision (RD-040). The `recommended_verdict` is a RECOMMENDATION the human triages on; it is NEVER acted upon automatically. `decision` is the human accept/reject marker, whose only value 4.1 can report is `pending` — the effective decision is a HUMAN action at the Phase-4 gate (4.4/4.6/4.7). ALWAYS present: when the 3.5 verdict_result has not landed yet, status is `not_yet_recommended` and no recommended_verdict is reported.

status.description: The 3.5 recommendation record's status carried through (recommended / no_scores / incomplete), or `not_yet_recommended` when the 3.5 verdict_result is not on the item yet. HONEST production status, never a verdict.

recommended_verdict.description: The 3.5 ADVISORY recommended verdict (PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE), surfaced for the human to triage. It is NEVER acted upon automatically. Deliberately named `recommended_verdict` (not `verdict`) so no consumer mistakes it for the effective decision. Present ONLY when a 3.5 verdict_result has landed (status != not_yet_recommended).

decision.description: The human accept/reject decision marker. ALWAYS `pending` — 4.1 NEVER reports a made decision; the human's actual selection is a SEPARATE, human-owned Phase-4 field 4.1 does not echo. Enumerated to exactly one value so this view can never assert a made decision. Preserves the human-gate covenant: the recommendation INFORMS; the human DECIDES + ACTS.

advisory.description: Always true: an explicit machine-readable flag that the recommended_verdict is ADVISORY and must NEVER be acted upon automatically. Defense-in-depth so a downstream consumer cannot treat this view's recommendation as an effective decision.

rubric_version.description: The shared 0-100 risk-rubric version from the 3.5 record, carried through.

summary.description: The 3.5 recommendation summary carried through (a bounded, DETERMINISTIC narrative that explicitly frames the result as ADVISORY). Inert text; never a verdict, never raw content.

status_detail.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable note about the recommendation status. Never a verdict, never raw content.

read_model_note.description: Optional short, bounded, non-executable note framing this as a DERIVED read-only status view whose recommendation is ADVISORY + human-gated. Descriptive, never a verdict.
